0.description: <hex:02084CE3E90C0DFF24020820E3E90C05FF0D476F6F64206576656E696E67FF0C476F6F64206D6F72726F7703FF2102081DE3E90C12FF09476F6F6420646179FF0D476F6F64206576656E696E670303> to you, adventurer. Have you any questions regarding the history of Little Ladies' Day or Hatching<hex:021F0103>tide, I am at your service.

6.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_GUIDEPDY00843_000_010
6.description: Once a year, when the peach blossoms come to bloom, Eorzea celebrates all the lovely and spirited young maidens who bring such joy to our realm.

7.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_GUIDEPDY00843_000_011
7.description: The origins of the holiday can be traced back to events that happened some three centuries past, when the Thorne Dynasty still reigned in Ul'dah.

8.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_GUIDEPDY00843_000_012
8.description: The plucky Princess Edvya, tired of being sequestered within palace walls by her overprotective father─the sultan Baldric Thorne─exchanged garb with a miller girl and wandered off into town in search of adventure.

9.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_GUIDEPDY00843_000_013
9.description: Upon learning of his daughter's disappearance, the sultan was stricken with panic. He summoned the palace guard─down to the last man─and ordered them to tear the city apart to see that no harm befell his precious princess.

10.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_GUIDEPDY00843_000_014
10.description: ...And tear the city apart they did. The poor miller whose daughter assisted the princess in her escape saw his house nigh ripped from the ground, while the family was threatened with imprisonment and worse.

11.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_GUIDEPDY00843_000_015
11.description: To the good fortune of all, Princess Edvya was soon found just outside the palace walls. When she confessed the true reason that she had run away, her father was racked with guilt for his actions. He had the miller's house rebuilt by his most skilled craftsmen, and offered to personally serve as seneschal to the miller girl for a day to atone for his actions.

12.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_GUIDEPDY00843_000_016
12.description: The commonfolk were deeply moved by their sultan's newfound compassion. The sultan himself, vowing to never forget the lessons he had learned, declared that each year he would serve as seneschal for a young girl chosen from the townspeople by lot.

13.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_GUIDEPDY00843_000_017
13.description: The tradition continued long after Sultan Baldric's death, living on even as the Thorne Dynasty gave way to the Ul. In time, it spread to other nations, where it took on new forms, eventually evolving into the Little Ladies' Day celebration that we know and love today.

14.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_GUIDEPDY00843_000_020
14.description: Princess Edvya was the one and only daughter of Sultan Baldric of House Thorne, the Hyuran noble house that ruled Ul'dah some three hundred years ago to the day.

15.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_GUIDEPDY00843_000_021
15.description: Her disappearance from the palace, the commotion that followed, and its eventual resolution─oft retold as the “Legend of the Lost Lady”─are said to represent the origins of the celebration we now know as Little Ladies' Day.

16.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_GUIDEPDY00843_000_022
16.description: It is said that before the events of that day, relations between the spirited princess and her stern, overly protective father were strained at best. Though the father claimed to love his daughter dearly, the form this love took was the stifling sort.

17.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_GUIDEPDY00843_000_023
17.description: The princess's disappearance and return changed everything. Sultan Baldric gained a newfound respect for his daughter's independent nature, while Princess Edvya realized that her father's treatment of her was born of simple misunderstanding, not lack of love.

18.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_GUIDEPDY00843_000_024
18.description: The bonds between the two grew only stronger in the months and years to follow, and the two came to be celebrated as the most ideal embodiment of father and daughter that the realm had ever seen.

19.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_GUIDEPDY00843_000_030
19.description: While Little Ladies' Day and Hatching<hex:021F0103>tide have up until this point been two separate events, this year the organizers of each have joined hands to bring twice the festive spirit to the realm.

20.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_GUIDEPDY00843_000_031
20.description: As you may already know, Little Ladies' Day is even now being held in Ul'dah, while Hatching<hex:021F0103>tide is filling Gridania with smiles. If you have the time, I urge you to take your fill of excitement at both celebrations.

21.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_GUIDEPDY00843_000_032
21.description: As you may already know, Hatching<hex:021F0103>tide is even now being held in Gridania, while Little Ladies' Day spreads smiles across Ul'dah. If you have the time, I urge you to take your fill of excitement at both celebrations.

22.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFA_000_040
22.description: <hex:020854E3E90C0DFF25020821E3E90C05FF0D476F6F64206576656E696E67FF0D476F6F64206D6F726E696E6703FF28020824E3E90C12FF10476F6F642064617920746F20796F75FF0D476F6F64206576656E696E670303>, friend. Might you be interested in learning about the Hatching<hex:021F0103>tide festivities?

23.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFA_000_041
23.description: A fledgling festival, Hatching<hex:021F0103>tide was born of a prophetic dream visited upon a Gridanian maiden named Jihli Aliapoh. In her dream, the Twelve Archons of old appeared, those heroes who saved the realm from the destruction of the Sixth Umbral Calamity.

24.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFA_000_042
24.description: Descending from the heavens atop beautifully decorated eggs, they said to Jihli, “Arise, young Dreamer, and make ready the vessels for our return.” And so she did─painstakingly painting and gilding eggs to match those from her vision.

25.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFA_000_043
25.description: Word of the prophecy spread, and Jihli attracted helpers to assist in her toils. After the Calamity, the festival grew further, as townsfolk and adventurers flocked to celebrate the Archons of yore, who many believe had some hand in delivering the realm once again.

26.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFA_000_044
26.description: For this year only, the organizers of Hatching<hex:021F0103>tide have joined hands with the planners of Little Ladies' Day in Ul'dah to create a joint celebration that spans two of Eorzea's city-states!

27.name: TEXT_FESPDYEST2024GUID_00843_EGGHUNTINGSTAFFA_000_050
27.description: If you're so inclined, I urge you to travel to Gridania and hunt eggs to your heart's content!
